rows.text: The LDP's report of 3 September 2008 says 福田康夫総理・総裁 announced his resignation on the 1st (１日に辞任表明), that is 1 September 2008.

locator.section: date line 【平成２０年 ９月 ３日】; first paragraph

rows.text: At the joint plenary meeting of party Diet members (両院議員総会) on 3 September 2008 the schedule decided by the presidential election administration committee was reported: notice on 10 September, voting and counting on 22 September, by the party's Diet members and three representatives from each of the 47 prefectural federations.
In his address (printed under 福田総理のあいさつは次の通り) 福田 says he announced his intention to resign (辞意表明) the day before yesterday and makes 'my last request as president' (私の総裁としての最後のお願い).
